headline: A 2000 executive order directed federal agencies to expand opportunities and access for disadvantaged businesses.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Clinton, aims to increase opportunities and access for businesses considered disadvantaged. Based on the title, it likely tells federal agencies to take steps to help these businesses take part in government programs or contracts. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: These businesses are the intended beneficiaries of efforts to widen their opportunities and access.
Agencies are likely directed to act to increase opportunities for disadvantaged businesses.
